[.claude/commands/eap-push.md#workflow]

## Workflow

1. Run `git status` to check for uncommitted changes
2. **If uncommitted changes exist:**
   - Show a summary of uncommitted changes
   - Ask: "You have uncommitted changes. Commit them before pushing? (Y/n)"
   - If yes: run the commit workflow:
     1. Read `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md` and run its Phases 1–4 convergence check unless the change is a trivial single-line fix per that Skill's own exclusion. If there is an active PR review cycle with open, unresolved review comments on the current branch, run `/pr-appr-resolve` first. If it redirects you to invoke `@pr-manager` instead of resolving directly, stop and hand control back to the user rather than proceeding — a Workflow cannot invoke an Agent for them. Do not proceed to staging until Phase 4 returns pass.
     2. Stage relevant files with `git add`
     3. Analyze changes and draft commit message following conventional commits format
     4. Create commit with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>` trailer
     5. Run `git status` to verify commit succeeded
   - If no: abort the push and inform the user they can use `git stash` or commit manually
3. If the working tree is clean and there are commits not yet pushed to the remote branch, read `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md` and run its Phases 1–4 convergence check against those unpushed commits (its own Scope section routes to exactly this case) unless the change is a trivial single-line fix per that Skill's own exclusion. If there is an active PR review cycle with open, unresolved review comments on the current branch, run `/pr-appr-resolve` first. If it redirects you to invoke `@pr-manager` instead of resolving directly, stop and hand control back to the user rather than proceeding — a Workflow cannot invoke an Agent for them. Do not proceed to push until Phase 4 returns pass. This applies regardless of how the commits were created — the gate runs before every push, not only the auto-commit path above.
4. Run `git log --oneline @{upstream}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || git log --oneline -5` to show what will be pushed
5. Confirm the remote and branch: `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{upstream} 2>/dev/null || echo "No upstream set"`
6. **If pushing to main/master:** warn and ask for confirmation before proceeding
7. If no upstream is set, push with `-u origin <current-branch>`
8. Otherwise, push with `git push`
9. Show the result

[.claude/commands/eap-push.md#guidelines]

## Guidelines

- Never use `--force` or `--force-with-lease` unless the user explicitly asks
- If pushing to main/master, warn the user and ask for confirmation
- Show the commits that will be pushed before executing
- Always handle uncommitted changes before pushing (either commit or abort)
- Follow the standard commit workflow when creating commits (include Co-Authored-By trailer)
